# GT-I8200 (goldenvess3g) vendor file manifest - PROPOSED, UNVERIFIED.
#
# This is a list of file NAMES only. It was derived from (a) the Koloses/device_i8200 proprietary list, (b) the audit of the
# rooted community /system dump in docs/phase-3-device-tree-feasibility.md and docs/phase-4-device-tree-skeleton.md, and
# (c) the transitive library dependencies of the listed files. The community dump is NOT a source of files.
# Files may only be extracted from VERIFIED OFFICIAL GT-I8200 firmware with extract-files.sh, which refuses anything else.
#
# Line format:   <path under system>   # flags
# Statuses:      (plain line) INCLUDE   |   "#DEFER"  = not extracted yet, reason given   |   "#EXCLUDE" = never extract, reason given
# Flags:         NON-PIE (Android 7 linker rejects it), TEXTREL (needs TARGET_NEEDS_PLATFORM_TEXT_RELOCATIONS),
#                NEEDS-LIBSTLPORT, SYMBOLS-AT-RISK(n) (n symbols not found in Android 7 sources / only in stock 4.2 libraries),
#                NOT-IN-KOLOSES-LIST (required by a listed file but missing from the community list),
#                OMITTED-FROM-COMMUNITY-LISTS (present in the dump but in neither community list), EABI4.
# A flag is a risk marker from static analysis, not a statement that the file works or fails.
#
# KNOWN GAPS (nothing to list, nothing to guess):
#   - sensord: started by the stock init, NOT present in the dump (see plan R8).
#   - Modem firmware: lives in the MODEM partition, not in /system. Never touched by this project.
#   - listed by Koloses but absent from the dump: bin/cp, bin/smd, xbin/iwconfig, xbin/zipalign
